title: Breakfast
levelNote: Six tiers in one file. Breakfast starts with an egg and a cup of tea, and ends with a paragraph about whether it is really the most important meal of the day.
goal: Talk about what you eat and drink for breakfast, order it at a cafe, and describe your morning habits.
goal_pt: Falar sobre o que você come e bebe no café da manhã, pedir em um café, e descrever seus hábitos matinais.

lines.text: Have you ever skipped breakfast on a busy morning?
Almost every week. I just don't have an appetite that early.
Really? I could never skip it. I need something balanced before I leave the house.
I understand, but I usually just grab coffee and eat leftovers from dinner instead.

Maybe. On weekends, though, I do cook a proper meal.
What do you make?
Pancakes, mostly. It is the one thing I never skip.

reading.title: Breakfast with my family
reading.text:
Every morning my mother makes breakfast for us. She makes eggs and toast. My little brother drinks milk, but I like tea.

On Sundays, we eat pancakes. My father makes them, and they are always sweet. We put honey on top.

Breakfast is my favourite meal. We sit together and talk before school.

questions.q: What does the family eat on Sundays?
Why does the writer like breakfast?

reading.title: The same breakfast every day
reading.text:
Some people eat something different every morning. Others eat exactly the same thing, year after year, and they will tell you it is not boring at all.

A fixed breakfast means one less decision before the day even starts. There is no thinking about what to buy, what to cook, or what to choose. The same bowl of cereal, the same cup of coffee, the same two minutes at the table.

It is not really about the food. It is about starting the day on ground that does not move.

questions.q: Why do some people eat the same breakfast every day?
What example of a fixed breakfast is given in the text?
What does the writer say this routine is really about?
options: Starting the day on ground that does not move

reading.title: The most important meal?
reading.text:
Breakfast has an odd reputation. For decades it was marketed as the most important meal of the day, largely by companies that happened to sell breakfast cereal. The science behind the claim was always thinner than the slogan suggested.

What the research does show is less dramatic and more interesting: it depends entirely on the person. Someone who trains early in the morning genuinely needs fuel before they start. Someone who wakes up without any appetite at all is not doing anything wrong by waiting until midday to eat.

Habits differ around the world for the same reason. A family in one country starts the day with something savoury, rice or fish or soup, while another reaches for something sweet, bread and jam or a bowl of cereal. Neither is more correct than the other. What actually matters is less which meal you call the most important, and more whether you are eating enough, at some point, to get through the day.

questions.q: According to the text, why was breakfast marketed as the most important meal?
options: Largely by companies that sold cereal
Because it helps you sleep better

questions.q: What does the text say about someone who trains early in the morning?
options: They genuinely need fuel before they start

questions.q: What does the writer say actually matters?
options: Whether you eat enough to get through the day
